      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FirstBatch" messageRef="Msg_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildMerge" name="Parts available for building"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Build" name="Build with parts"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockLevel" name="Stock of a single part compared to limits 5 and 3?" default="Flow_StockOk"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ComplaintMail" name="Write complaint mail to friends about web shops" messageRef="Msg_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComplaintSent" name="Complaint mail sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder fastest parts" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder cheapest parts" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Stock checked"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_NextBatch" name="Next parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_NextBatch" messageRef="Msg_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="Start_Project" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_RecordOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compare" sourceRef="Task_RecordOffers" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateList" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Task_CreateOrderList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSingleShopCheck" sourceRef="Task_CreateOrderList" targetRef="Gateway_SingleShop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShop" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SingleShop" targetRef="Task_OrderOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enoughAtOneShop == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SeveralShops" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SingleShop" targetRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShopMerge" sourceRef="Task_OrderOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_OrdersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SeveralShopsMerge" sourceRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_OrdersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitFirstBatch" sourceRef="Gateway_OrdersMerge" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatchToBuild" sourceRef="Event_FirstBatch" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartBuilding" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildMerge" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_Build" targetRef="Gateway_StockLevel"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockZero" name="Stock is zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Task_ComplaintMail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock == 0}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow3" name="Stock below 3" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock > 0 && stock < 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow5" name="Stock below 5" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock >= 3 && stock < 5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockOk" name="Stock sufficient" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplaintEnd" sourceRef="Task_ComplaintMail" targetRef="End_ComplaintSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastestMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapestMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitNextBatch" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Event_NextBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextBatchToBuild" sourceRef="Event_NextBatch" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a later phase of the same process begins only after an earlier decision or acceptance point has been reached, and that phase is a continuation of the same process rather than an independently triggered one: Model that later phase as an activity (task) placed after the decision or acceptance point in the existing sequence flow. Do not give it a new start event, and do not give the phase's completion a new end event unless the description states a separate outcome.
rules.situation: the description says that after a first incoming delivery an ongoing work activity starts and then continues in the same process, and it states no separate outcome or end for that work

rules.instruction: When the description states that a follow-up action depends on how a tracked quantity compares with one or more stated limits, with a different action for each limit: Model an exclusive gateway whose question names that tracked quantity and the comparison with the stated limit, with one outgoing flow per limit condition. Do not name the gateway after the progress or completion of the activity that uses the quantity.
rules.situation: the description states that a follow-up action depends on how a tracked quantity compares with one or more stated limits, with a different action for each limit

rules.instruction: When the description says the participant itself must query several external suppliers to learn their available quantities, cost and lead times before choosing among their answers: Model the querying as a user task performed by the participant, placed before the exclusive gateway that decides among the answers. Do not model it as a receive task, since the participant's own inquiry is the unit of work and the wait is not the modeled activity.
rules.situation: the description says the participant itself must query several external suppliers to learn their available quantities, cost and lead times before choosing among their answers

rules.instruction: When the description says that a performer must look up or inquire about several figures (for example quantities, costs and lead times) from several outside sources before making a decision, and does not state that a message is sent to those sources: Model the inquiry as a userTask performed by that performer, placed before the decision gateway that depends on its results. Do not model it as a sendTask, because no outgoing message is described.
rules.situation: the description says that a performer must look up or inquire about several figures (for example quantities, costs and lead times) from several outside sources before making a decision, and does not state that a message is sent to those sources

rules.instruction: When the description says an activity is repeated once for each external occurrence (something arriving, or a response to something that was sent out) and the process keeps repeating until a completion or satisfaction condition holds, looping back when that condition is not yet met: Model the repeated activity as a task. Wait for each occurrence with an intermediate catch event placed before the decision. After the wait, use a decision gateway that tests the completion condition. Place an exclusive merge gateway before the repeated task so that the first entry and the loop-back both enter through it. Connect the 'not yet met' outgoing flow of the decision back to that merge gateway, and leave the 'met' flow to continue the process. Do not omit the wait before the decision, and do not connect the decision directly back to the task without the merge.
rules.situation: the description says an activity is repeated once for each external occurrence (something arriving, or a response to something that was sent out) and the process keeps repeating until a completion or satisfaction condition holds, looping back when that condition is not yet met
rules.source: learned guideline (refines EVT-03), generalized from EXS-071

rules.instruction: When the description says that a performer must send a request to several outside parties and then find out, from their answers, the quantities, costs and times they offer, before a decision gateway uses these results: After the send activity that issues the request to the outside parties, model a separate user task, performed by the responsible role, in which the answers are obtained and recorded. Place this task before the decision gateway that uses those answers, and connect it in sequence. Do not let the send activity stand alone as the only step that yields the information the decision needs.
rules.situation: the description says that a performer must send a request to several outside parties and then find out, from their answers, the quantities, costs and times they offer, before a decision gateway uses these results
